ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis successively marks the vernal equinox, summer solstice, autumnal equinox, winter solstice, and vernal equinox; the left vertical axis is noon solar altitude, and the right vertical axis is day length. 1, 2, 3, and 4 are broken lines of the noon solar altitude of four places changing with the seasons, and 5 is the day length change curve. Observing the two broken lines ② and ③, at the vernal equinox or autumnal equinox position, the noon solar altitude corresponding to place ③ is lower than that of place ②. Reasoning: At the vernal and autumnal equinoxes, noon solar altitude satisfies H=90°-|latitude|, so the lower the noon solar altitude, the greater the absolute value of latitude. From the figure it can be known that the absolute value of latitude of place ③ is greater than that of place ②, that is, place ③ is farther from the equator. When only solar radiation is considered, the higher the latitude, the more obvious the seasonal changes of solar altitude and day length, and the greater the annual variation amplitude of solar radiation; therefore the annual temperature range is greater. So the annual temperature range at place ③ is greater than that at place ②.

method.method_draft: 先读图：横轴为春分、夏至、秋分、冬至、春分；②、③是两条表示正午太阳高度季节变化的折线。比较两线在春分或秋分时的正午太阳高度，可见③地的正午太阳高度低于②地。由春秋分正午太阳高度 H=90°-|纬度| 可知，③地纬度绝对值大于②地，即③地离赤道更远。再由题干限定“只考虑太阳辐射”，气温年较差主要取决于太阳辐射年变化幅度；纬度越高，太阳高度和昼长的季节变化越明显，太阳辐射年变化越大。因此③地气温年较差大于②地，即 T3>T2。
